body:
Raised 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles) by post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Affected PR #1012, merge `0de4b1f4183d6cf7c5fc6c78b6316f0f3a6b1e15`, head `475edce76b0c66514fc2431fb045dd4a62943e17`, closed parent #999.

The retained `data/regional-review/followup-kosovo-422-district-source-20261005/reproduce.py` checks nine baseline pins and reads its original world/source bytes from immutable commit `96f2a6d201236ba62f471535db240b123de60c09`. However, it directly reads the current packet's captured issue/related-scope/KAS transcription and current script without validating their complete retained hashes. It only checks the KAS transcription for seven names and 38 unique municipality names. Finally it unconditionally overwrites historical `source-crosswalk.json`. A successful reproduction is therefore not proof that the retained transcription/packet/code bytes were used, and can replace the original evidence. The external manifest has byte receipts; the runner does not enforce its candidate-input receipts.

Actual isolated verification: two original-script runs, with only the exact output destination and corresponding read redirected to exclusive fresh private files, reproduce the 10,417-byte report exactly, SHA256 `7339a45153c1a7e6f7c594b6c87be2f8b6294e7407ec63ab2598c839bb4cc5e7`. All original packet bytes remain unchanged. This is a reproducibility safeguard defect, not an allegation that the original transcription or result is factually wrong.

Executed reproduction of the failure: at the complete-file `Path.read_bytes` boundary for `kas-statistical-regions.json`, change only the first Prishtinë municipality name from `Gllogoc` to `AUDITOR_SYNTHETIC_MUNICIPALITY`. Preserve the original source checksum field, seven region labels, all other names and all baseline/source geometry. Redirect the final report to a fresh exclusive private file. The original runner exits successfully, reports 38 municipalities, and emits the synthetic municipality label in its KAS list. The changed 10,440-byte output SHA256 is `c521c0409104420c1417d233ee94d633e4e6bdf8087bdaff9644eaa98d766330`. No actual input was edited; this is a complete-file read-boundary fixture, not an extract standing in for an oversized original.

Expected: reject changed/wrong-baseline/source/packet/transcription/code bytes before output generation, bind source and transcription provenance to actual immutable consumed bytes, and write only fresh exclusive versioned results. Keep all original dated evidence immutable.

Bounded additive source-only erratum, at most two PRs, owned exclusively under `data/regional-review/kosovo-district-reproduction-999-erratum/`:

- Add a separate whole-input-guarded runner/erratum using the 23 actual original input descriptors below. Account for exactly the three #999 Atlas subjects; the four #1008 features and all seven source shapes/parents are original read-only lineage contexts, not an expansion of subject-edit scope. Retain the exact 3+4 partition and seven-to-38 name-only interpretation, with the statistical-region proposal field and all source/reuse limits.
- Execute two runs to exclusive fresh outputs, compare with the retained original report and retain meaningful rejection controls for wrong packet/transcription/code/baseline bytes and an existing output. Include the actual synthetic name drift above. Do not edit the old script, KAS extract, report, source originals, issue snapshots, hierarchy or geometry. Distinguish historical source dates from actual execution provenance.
- Prepare the new versioned manifest with complete consumed-file accounting, actual bound metrics and applicable control receipts, then obtain substantive independent exact-head implementation/source review. Any source/geographic claim requires its own authentic evidence; do not infer fact or legal validity from hashes/counts.

Success: reject the demonstrated changed transcription before report emission; all 23 original consumed inputs have exact immutable byte pins; exact three subject IDs and all seven source/parent context identities preserved; old bytes/hash unchanged; two deterministic fresh-output runs and meaningful negative controls retained. Stay within 32 MiB per ordinary/decoded object, 256 MiB per genuinely complete phase and 512 descriptors; recalculate admission, with no chunk/extract/stream bypass. The Auditor's original complete phase (including two MiB output reserve) was 24,680,010 bytes.

Readiness: #999 is closed with canonical author claim released. Complete open/closed issue and open-PR pagination found only closed original #999 and its closed duplicate #1000 for this packet; no reproduction erratum owns this defect or new path. #1008 remains open under its distinct four-subject source/identity adjudication scope. #1159/#1169 address different original packets and subject scopes; their ownership is preserved. This task uses available retained evidence and does not depend on restoring missing official publications or solving legal reuse questions. No implementation claim is taken.

Limits: the Auditor reproduced the historical crosswalk and checked actual scoped source/Atlas IDs, parent links and the 3+4 partition. The original KAS PDF, law/census/OSM policy bodies and historical service/snapshot provenance remain unauthenticated under GitHub-only access. Seven labels and 38 unique names cannot authenticate transcription, polygon equivalence, current legal roles, licenses or approved geography. This issue does not restore/approve those facts or authorize shared edits, imports, merging, deployment or publisher acceptance. The original PR audit remains Incomplete.

Complete synthetic transcription: 2340 bytes, SHA256 `34ed4c2393dbea07e64cfe00728eccf69611f7137cc86c24d5c49f121a18effd`; complete probe admission 24682350 bytes.
